' The precedence parser builds a binary tree. Each node is owned by its
' parent until evaluation consumes it. The older linear-tree evaluator
' below remains available to the original sample.
Private Function EvaluateParsedExpression(ByVal Node As AstNode Ptr) As Double
    Dim Value As Double
    If Node->Type_ = TokenType.TOKEN_NUMBER Then
        Value = Node->Value
    Else
        Dim LeftValue As Double = EvaluateParsedExpression(Node->Left_)
        Dim RightValue As Double = EvaluateParsedExpression(Node->Right_)
        Select Case Node->Type_
            Case TokenType.TOKEN_PLUS: Value = LeftValue + RightValue
            Case TokenType.TOKEN_MINUS: Value = LeftValue - RightValue
            Case TokenType.TOKEN_MULTIPLY: Value = LeftValue * RightValue
            Case TokenType.TOKEN_DIVIDE
                If RightValue = 0 Then ExpressionError("Division by zero.")
                Value = LeftValue / RightValue
        End Select
    End If
    Delete Node
    Return Value
End Function

function convertBrowserImage() as long
  '' The worker sends tightly packed RGBA rows. Bitmap owns aligned BGRA
  '' storage, so translate channels and respect its stride at each row.
  const maxSide as long = 1600
  dim as long w = valint( command( 2 ) )
  dim as long h = valint( command( 3 ) )
  if( w < 1 orelse h < 1 orelse w > maxSide orelse h > maxSide ) then return 1

  dim as gsFunc method
  select case command( 4 )
    case "luma"
      method = @gs_luma
    case "lightness"
      method = @gs_lightness
    case "average"
      method = @gs_average
    case "value"
      method = @gs_value
    case else
      return 1
  end select

  '' IMAGECREATE needs a graphics mode even when no display is opened.
  if( screenres( 1, 1, 32, 1, fb.GFX_NULL ) <> 0 ) then return 1
  dim as long f = freefile()
  if( open( "/source.rgba" for binary access read as #f ) <> 0 ) then return 1
  if( lof( f ) <> w * h * 4 ) then
    close #f
    return 1
  end if

  var sourceImage = Fb.Bitmap( w, h )
  if( sourceImage.pixels = 0 ) then
    close #f
    return 1
  end if
  redim as ubyte rowBytes( 0 to w * 4 - 1 )
  for y as long = 0 to h - 1
    if( get( #f, , rowBytes() ) <> 0 ) then
      close #f
      return 1
    end if
    dim as uint32 ptr pixels = sourceImage.pixels + y * sourceImage.pitchInPixels
    for x as long = 0 to w - 1
      dim as long offset = x * 4
      pixels[x] = rgba( rowBytes(offset), rowBytes(offset + 1), rowBytes(offset + 2), rowBytes(offset + 3) )
    next
  next
  close #f

  var resultImage = grayscale( sourceImage, method )
  if( resultImage.pixels = 0 ) then return 1
  f = freefile()
  if( open( "/result.rgba" for binary access write as #f ) <> 0 ) then return 1
  for y as long = 0 to h - 1
    dim as uint32 ptr pixels = resultImage.pixels + y * resultImage.pitchInPixels
    for x as long = 0 to w - 1
      dim as long offset = x * 4
      dim as ubyte gray = RGBA_R( pixels[x] )
      rowBytes(offset) = gray
      rowBytes(offset + 1) = gray
      rowBytes(offset + 2) = gray
      rowBytes(offset + 3) = RGBA_A( pixels[x] )
    next
    if( put( #f, , rowBytes() ) <> 0 ) then
      close #f
      return 1
    end if
  next
  close #f
  return 0
end function

if( command( 1 ) = "--rgba" ) then end convertBrowserImage()

function make_browser_icons() as Texture2D
    ' Preserve the tile IDs and 8-pixel cells used by the dungeon renderer.
    ' The browser atlas draws its own symbols with raylib's default font.
    const cell_size as long = 8
    const columns as long = 8
    const rows as long = 11
    const panel_fill as long = 5
    dim as string symbols = "@+*.:#%+" & _
                            "!|/+-_:#" & _
                            "srbtgwok" & _
                            "mnvadqef" & _
                            "uijcxyzX" & _
                            "SHAF^+-X" & _
                            "hH!pmh*K" & _
                            "..!!+*#M" & _
                            "###|---+" & _
                            "####+##+" & _
                            "+--|--++"
    dim as Image atlas = GenImageColor(columns * cell_size, rows * cell_size, BLANK)
    if atlas.data = 0 then return type<Texture2D>(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    for tile as long = 0 to columns * rows - 1
        dim as long x = (tile mod columns) * cell_size
        dim as long y = (tile \ columns) * cell_size
        if tile = panel_fill then
            ' The notification panel stretches this tile into a background.
            ImageDrawRectangleRec(@atlas, type<Rectangle>(x, y, cell_size, cell_size), WHITE)
        else
            dim as string symbol = mid(symbols, tile + 1, 1)
            dim as Image glyph = ImageText(strptr(symbol), 10, WHITE)
            if glyph.data <> 0 then
                ' Leave one transparent column on either side of a glyph.
                ImageResizeNN(@glyph, cell_size - 2, cell_size)
                ImageDraw(@atlas, glyph, type<Rectangle>(0, 0, glyph.width, glyph.height), _
                          type<Rectangle>(x + 1, y, glyph.width, glyph.height), WHITE)
                UnloadImage(glyph)
            end if
        end if
    next
    dim as Texture2D texture = LoadTextureFromImage(atlas)
    UnloadImage(atlas)
    return texture
end function
#endif

#ifdef __FB_JS__
' FreeBASIC stores BGRA pixels. WebGL needs tightly packed RGBA bytes.
private sub upload_web_texture(byval picture as FB.IMAGE ptr)
    if picture = 0 then exit sub
    dim as long w = picture->width, h = picture->height
    if w <= 0 or h <= 0 then exit sub
    dim as ulongint size = culngint(w) * h * 4
    if size > &h7fffffff or picture->pitch < culngint(w) * 4 then exit sub
    dim as ubyte ptr rgba_pixels = allocate(cuint(size))
    if rgba_pixels = 0 then exit sub
    dim as ubyte ptr pixel_dest = rgba_pixels
    dim as ubyte ptr pixels = cptr(ubyte ptr, picture) + sizeof(FB.IMAGE)
    for y as long = 0 to h - 1
        dim as ubyte ptr source_row = pixels + y * picture->pitch
        for x as long = 0 to w - 1
            pixel_dest[0] = source_row[2]
            pixel_dest[1] = source_row[1]
            pixel_dest[2] = source_row[0]
            pixel_dest[3] = source_row[3]
            pixel_dest += 4
            source_row += 4
        next
    next
    glTexImage2d(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, GL_RGBA, w, h, 0, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, rgba_pixels)
    deallocate(rgba_pixels)
end sub
#endif

	If Len(spec) > 4096 Then Exit Constructor
	For i As Integer = 0 To Len(spec) - 1
		If spec[i] <= 32 OrElse spec[i] = 127 OrElse spec[i] = 92 Then Exit Constructor
	Next i

	Dim schemeEnd As Integer = InStr(spec, "://")
	If schemeEnd = 0 Then Exit Constructor
	Dim protocol As String = LCase(Left(spec, schemeEnd - 1))
	If protocol <> "http" AndAlso protocol <> "https" Then Exit Constructor

	' Split at the first separator after the scheme. Later occurrences
	' of the host or the protocol belong to the path, query or fragment.
	Dim hostStart As Integer = schemeEnd + Len("://")
	Dim pathStart As Integer = InStr(hostStart, spec, Any "/?#")
	If pathStart = 0 Then pathStart = Len(spec) + 1
	Dim host As String = Mid(spec, hostStart, pathStart - hostStart)
	If host = "" OrElse InStr(host, "@") > 0 Then Exit Constructor
	this.fHost = host
	this.fPath = Mid(spec, pathStart)
	this.fProtocol = protocol
#endif
end constructor
